About the UBBC Tuesday Night Ride group ride

A casual ride through city streets and alleys on both sides of the river, then back to a bar for a post-ride drink. No one gets dropped. Red Bike station at 14th and Elm if you need wheels.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
